applies: the JA Joomla T4 quickstarts: one site module like tracy-base (Claude Cowork content.update kind module + moduleAssignment, every page), first in header-r unless a template names another early position. A released template whose stylesheets read their own palette through `var(--ds-c-<role>, <hex>)` (scripts/tokenize.mjs) follows the system across the page; one that does not still takes T4's runtime colours, fonts and headings

module.title: Tracy design system
module.why: header-r is in the header block every JA T4 layout renders; the flow fails a template whose page never carries the slot marker, so a missing position cannot pass silently

specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
extraNote: Bootstrap 5 as T4 ships it under every JA template (forms, pagination, tables, alerts): its colours take the roles they play there; #e9ecef is both a fill (surface-warm order puts surface first) and a line
accentNote: T4's link colours are TEXT: they take the accent made readable on the page (--ds-c-accent-text), not the fill; a stylesheet painting text with T4's primary reads the same (tokenize.mjs accentVars)
genericNote: the slot writes no short token names (--bg, --accent…) here: a JA template may define them itself; everything reads --ds-c-*
runtimeRgbNote: Bootstrap 5 inside T4 paints links, primary and the page through RGB triplets: each takes the triplet of its role's worn colour; the primary triplet takes the READABLE accent: Bootstrap's .link-primary paints text with it (JA Trip), and a fill a shade deeper still reads
classifyNote: a text colour no palette names, on the page side of light, follows as body, muted or meta text by its contrast with the page
